notes.title: Celbugs v1.04 is out now!
notes.content:
New year, new patch! As usual, I've just polished a few things up for a smoother Celbugging experience.

[h1]Version 1.04 Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cleaned up some files to reduce the size of the game.
[*]Changed the icon of the character speaking in the game's final cutscene.
[*]A reference to "Battles" has been changed to "Bug Battles" for clarity.
[/list]
[h2](Cel)Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Super long Celbug names weren’t being displayed correctly in the header of their info boxes.
[*]The dialogue icons introduced in v1.03 had a small visual bug in which, on some resolutions, there was a small gap between the dialogue box and the character's picture.
[*]The achievements tracking total Celbugs bred and total Gnats destroyed were not cumulative across save files as intended.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2571330/Celbugs/

notes.title: Celbugs v1.03 is out now!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who's been giving Celbugs a whirl this holiday season! It means a lot to see people playing - and hopefully having a good time with - the game. I've taken the opportunity to polish things up a bit.

[h1]Version 1.03 Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]UI icons have been updated with the intent of being more consistent and clearer at lower resolutions.
[list][*]This affects the navigation buttons on Celbug Island and in Bug Battles, as well as the Favourite button[/list][*]Dialogue boxes now contain the name, and a picture of, the character speaking where appropriate.
[/list]
[h2](Cel)Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]In the Inventory, the Vurdice Leaf would be displayed when no item was selected instead of the intended graphic
[*]At some aspect ratios, UI buttons were unintentionally clickable while dialogue boxes were onscreen
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2571330/Celbugs/

notes.title: Celbugs v1.02 is out now!
notes.content:
Another day, another small quality of life update! Get a load of these patch notes. If you haven't already gotten your hands on Celbugs, why not give it a whirl? Or, I suppose, you could watch this space, in the event that I decided to discount the game in the spirit of this spooky season. [i](hint, hint)[/i]

[h1]Version 1.02 Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now tag Celbugs as Favourites!
[list]
[*]There's a little star button in a Celbug's info box. Click on it to Favourite that Celbug!
[*]Use the special search term “fave” to filter a search to only show your Favourite Celbugs
[/list][/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Significantly increased the odds across the board for Celbugs to appear with unusual colourations or features
[list]
[*]Getting your High Score Sum to hit a certain milestone now also bumps your odds up - so go bust some Gnats!
[/list]
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2571330/Celbugs/

notes.title: Celbugs Version 1.01 is out now!
notes.content:
Hello! If you’ve been playing Celbugs, I hope you’ve been having a whale of a time. The Version 1.01 update is out now - it’s a pretty small one, focusing on quality-of-life and bug fixes.

If you haven’t played Celbugs yet for some bizarre reason, now’s your chance! Come bust some Gnats.
[h1]
Version 1.01 Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added search filters! When searching through your Celbug collection, you can type “:” followed by comma-separated phrases to filter the list of Celbugs returned
[list]
 [*] For example, [i]“:6r,grown”[/i] yields all Celbugs who have at least 6 red cells and who are grown
 [*] For a more comprehensive breakdown, check the in-game Help window.[/list]
[*] Celbugs will no longer move right after you’ve interacted with them, hopefully making breeding a bit easier
[/list]

[h2](Cel)Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Celbugs will no longer occasionally spawn in the ocean
[*] The scroll wheel can now be used as intended to scroll through your Celbug collection, your list of Bug Battle rewards, and the Bug Battle selection menu
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2571330/Celbugs/
